stations.title: Card company
stations.text: Pays out every card payment of the month.

stations.title: Your query
stations.gap: Stops before the last day ends

stations.title: Month-end books
stations.text: Takings per method, to the penny.

captions: At Mallowfield Seeds, Clemency finds November's card takings short of the card company's.
Cash matches, but the report stops before most of the last day is over.
You show what is missing, then fix the takings and the seeds of the year.
Now November's card takings match the card company's to the penny.
Same payments, same month. Every edge of a report is where it should be.
